translation: Greatly hot, toxic. It governs removing cold of the five viscera and six bowels, cold damage (傷寒), warm malaria (溫瘧), great wind (大風), failure of sweating, retained drink and retained food in the heart and abdomen (心腹留飲、宿食), stopping [diarrhea], descending diarrhea, seminal emission (泄精), residual disease after childbirth and nursing in women (女子字乳余疾), dispersing wind-evil (風邪), masses (瘕結), and edema (水腫)...
